name: PAX West
blurb: An annual gaming convention in Seattle with video game panels, developer talks, exhibitors, concerts, tabletop gaming and esports.

editions.evidence: JSON-LD Event 'PAX West' 2027-09-03 to 2027-09-06 @ Seattle, WA; homepage: 'LEVEL 2026 COMPLETE. SEE YOU NEXT YEAR: SEPTEMBER 3-6, 2027' and 'Sep 3 - 6, 2027 Seattle, WA'; venue address '900 Pine Street, Seattle, WA 98101' is the Seattle Convention Center.

notes: No dedicated key-art/og image was found on the rendered homepage (only old footer backgrounds and a feature background), so the cover uses the site's own PAX West logo. Guests page combines a 'GUESTS' section and a 'PANELISTS' section; both were picked from the same extract (candidates #1-84); #85 is an affiliate-link disclaimer and #86 a cookie-banner logo, both skipped. Organizer shown via both the ReedPop and RX (RELX) footer logos. Verify pass (2026-10-05): current -- extracted section labels are clean ('GUESTS'/'PANELISTS', no 'Coming Soon'/TBA anywhere) and picks carry specific per-day schedule text (e.g. 'Panels Sat', 'Concerts Mon') consistent with the show's own Fri Sep 3 – Mon Sep 6, 2027 run, so the lineup stands. Refute attempt (2026-10-05): refuted -> none-yet -- that 'current' call only checked that section labels said GUESTS/PANELISTS with no literal TBA text and that schedule tags matched the show's Fri-Mon pattern, but PAX West always runs Fri-Mon so 'Panels Sat'/'Concerts Mon' proves nothing about which year; the homepage's own 'LEVEL 2026 COMPLETE. SEE YOU NEXT YEAR' text (already in this file's dates evidence) means the prior edition ended about a month before this check, and an independent search confirms Matthew Mercer, Anjali Bhimani, Jerry Holkins, Samantha Beart, Mike Krahulik, Mason Lieberman, Ify Nwadiwe, Dan Olson, Lucie Pohl, Kris Straub and Anne Yatco were all guests of that just-concluded PAX West 2026 -- the same names picked here -- with zero per-guest evidence anywhere on the page tying any of the 84 to 2027 specifically, so the whole page is last show's still-live roster; guests set to none-yet and lineup/textOnlyGuests removed.
